<thought>From the measurements, each intermediate node (X1, X2, X3, N_b1, N_c1, N_c2, N_c3, N_d1, N_d2, N_d3) lies on a distinct series branch between terminals A and B, because the resistance from A to the node plus the resistance from the node to B always equals the total A‑B resistance of 125 Ω. Therefore the circuit consists of ten parallel branches, each branch containing two resistors in series. The resistor values are taken directly from the measured half‑branch resistances, and the connections are listed accordingly.</thought>
